task: Find King's textures in the Tekken 3 BNS archive
resume_brief: Complete. Found King's real textures at BNS 95 (not 87 as previously thought). 59 TIMs (IDs 6213-6271) with jaguar spots, blue pants, jaguar mask face. Documented full BNS organization pattern in docs/BNS-ORGANIZATION-PATTERN.md. Textures at renders/king/textures/real_king/. Key correction: BNS 87 is LEI, BNS 95 is KING. The earlier king_full_front.png render is actually Lei, not King.
